message:
A new campaign is being created. Gather the player's campaign brief and content boundaries, build the world and write `campaign/campaign.md`.

Present a spoiler-free world proposal as an ordinary message: premise, tone and the surface situation they would begin in. Invite revisions and revise the proposal and files with the player. Call `task_complete` only after they approve the world. Character creation follows in the next stage.
A rain-soaked harbour city of rival guilds.
Make it more hopeful.
Yes, that world works for me.

The player approved the world. Open character creation with spoiler-free character hooks and the choice to adapt a hook, bring a character file or build one together.

Agree the vitals, backstory and placement with the player. Write the four PC files and any backstory canon, then call `task_complete` when the player has confirmed the character and its files are complete.
A half-elf rogue named Dallid.

The player has confirmed their character. Finish campaign setup: one major arc personal to this PC, with its level pacing; at least one minor arc hooked into it; and the initial entity, arc and dashboard state stamped `as-of: S0`.

You may delegate focused authoring to the `author` subagent. Make one `task` call at a time, waiting for it before starting another.

Disk checks show these deliverables still need work. Preserve the completed work:

- Exactly one major arc is required; found 0.
- At least one minor arc hooked into the major arc is required.

Report when done.

Role: check-init. Campaign init is complete — all world entities, the character, arcs, and state have been authored. Verify the full `campaign/` directory against your `check-init` skill. Read the files you need from disk; report gaps.

Plan session 1 into `campaign/sessions/1/plan.md`. Work from the last session's digest if there is one, the threads dashboard, the arcs and the state. Advance at least one arc, and give every new entity the plan needs its own file. When the plan is written, report only that it is ready — nothing of what is in it.

Role: check-plan. Verify the draft session plan below per your check-plan skill. The plan is the full text the dm just authored, inline here, before it is finalized.
